snapshot.note: index.html and the i18n JSON were being edited while this ran; where-lines refer to this snapshot only. Re-locate by key.

method.width: PIL ImageFont on assets/fonts/pk-body-700.woff2 (sans), CinzelDecorative-Bold.ttf (display ASCII), Georgia Bold.ttf (dock serif); CJK counted 1 em; emoji 0.95 em. Calibration: gameover.restart 580 px (UI reviewer ~576), shield.expired 574 px (reviewer ~573), storm line 450 px with 1-digit round (reviewer 445). Treat as +-3 %.

budgets.note: unit popup 560 = reviewer-confirmed threshold; a unit stands at x 160..760 (player) or 1160..1760 (AI), so any popup wider than 2 x unit x is clipped at the canvas edge: clamp ft.x in code instead of relying on length. Other budgets are my estimates (marked in table).

meta.font_note: PK Body woff2 has no CJK glyphs, so Chinese on the canvas and in the DOM uses PingFang TC / Microsoft JhengHei / Noto Sans TC by fallback; zh widths are 1 em per character.

fixed.note: Applied the proposed shorter English strings; weather.storm is 414.1 px, below the 440 px hard limit but above the 400 px comfort budget.
Applied the short dock-chip labels Bones, Mage, Bat, and Bell.
Corrected stale instructions, released shield placement, the Silver Cross Combo, and the stray 1-2 tag.
Standardized damage −15% and Triple Ghost Flame.
Standardized terms for heal, character, opponent, round, and restart.
Uses Tap for touch instructions and US spelling defense.
Added to both language files with matching placeholder sets.
Applied the bilingual name, Chinese short name, and short English description.

remaining.note: Task 177 preserves Bat Assassin and 盾衛 / Guard.
The page does not use this unlisted key.
